name: RSVP List
description: Let users RSVP to events and give admins the attendee list.
project_description:
RSVP is an initialism derived from the French phrase Répondez s'il vous plaît, meaning "Please respond" to require confirmation of an invitation. The initialism "RSVP" is no longer used much in France, where it is considered formal.

 This module provides the ability to add an RSVP invitation block on nodes inside Drupal with this it's possible invite guests for sub-events like a rehearsal dinner or post-conference breakout session. After realize the submission of the email using the created form field inside the block, administrators could check the values and persons emails confirming their presence on events. 

 Into the Reports it's possible to check the submited values from anonymous and regular users.

 
 admin/config/content/rsvplist 
 
 We could configure the visibility of this block respecting Drupal permissions:

 
 admin/config/content/rsvplist 
 
 Using the configurations page admin/config/content/rsvplist it's possible select the specified node types, which an RSVP option will be available and can be enabled while that node is being edited.
